posts:
A seven-figure ad buy praises Mike Rogers for demanding AI safeguards, but his actual record tells a very different story. 🌐
Evidence: AI safety champion, Corporate greenwashing, Protect AI investments
#Aletheia #Tech #USPol

An Alliance for a Better Future ad campaign highlights Mike Rogers' national security credentials, claiming he will make AI safety and strict guardrails a top priority in the Senate.
Stated Judgement: (+0.80, +0.50) — Greater Good

Rogers has invested up to $2.6M in AI-profiting firms and dismissed safety pauses as "fearmongering," while his opponent actually advocates for public ownership and strict pauses.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.90, -0.88) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception. The campaign uses a massive ad buy to brand a pro-industry investor as an AI safety champion, actively co-opting the safety narrative.
Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 1.70, Uncertainty z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Mike Rogers Record: FAIL (-0.90, -0.88) — Profits from AI while opposing actual safety pauses.
- ABF Ad Campaign: FAIL (-0.85, -0.80) — Corporate-funded safety-washing of a pro-industry candidate.
The Alliance for a Better Future launched a seven-figure ad campaign in Michigan framing Mike Rogers as an AI safety advocate, despite his deep financial ties to the AI industry.

The Poison:
By framing corporate-friendly "national security frameworks" as "safeguards," the ad co-opts the public demand for safety to protect industry profits from real regulation.
The Plane Error is Metaphysical (WHO): the ad claims the beneficiary is the American family, but the actual beneficiary is the AI industry and Rogers' own investment portfolio.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a classic Helxis maneuver. The ad baits voters with the language of "AI safety" and "guardrails" but switches the actual policy to a corporate-friendly framework that avoids real pauses, protecting Rogers' $2.6M AI investments.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The safety narrative is fully co-opted to shield corporate expansion.

The Unavoidable Truth: Rogers is heavily invested in the very AI companies he claims he will regulate.

The Unavoidable Lie: A candidate who calls safety pauses "fearmongering" is leading the charge for AI safety.

Alethekanon:
When a politician's portfolio directly profits from the rapid expansion of an unregulated industry, their "safeguards" will always favor profit over protection.

Awwthekanon:
It's heartbreaking when people's genuine fears about the future of technology are used as a marketing shield to protect corporate wealth.

Brothekanon:
Bro, calling AI safety "fearmongering" while dropping millions on ads saying you're the AI safety guy is next-level corporate greenwashing.

Spirithekanon:
"For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also." Matthew 6:21 FAIL
A leader cannot truly guard the public interest when their personal wealth is bound to the unchecked growth of the industry they promise to restrain.
